g.text: Creates the adapters with the profile's factory
(Abstract Factory: Local or Server), builds the
ingestion chain, creates the services and the
primary adapters and subscribes the observer.
It is not a layer: nothing depends on it.
CONSUMED by the presentation layer (dashed arrow).
This is where the dependency is inverted: swapping SQLite
for PostgreSQL does not touch the domain.
Every service except the dispatch one uses
base class; only the Access one is drawn.
